skills.skill_desc: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font> on the target, up to 5 stacks. <font color="a6aafb">Ninjutsu: Demon Feast</font> can only be cast on targets with full stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font>.

The skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Dark Ninjutsu</font>. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP.
When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals 600<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, recovers 150<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.

Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving <font color="a6aafb">dark mist</font> in front that deals 90<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area every 0.5s, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit).
The <font color="a6aafb">dark mist</font> slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.

Hanzo charges into battle as <font color="a6aafb">Hanekage</font>, consuming 170 Energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it's a hero. He gains 15 Energy when attacking a hero, and 45 Energy when attacking the Turtle or the Lord. When Energy runs out, Hanzo's body will be slowly drawn to <font color="a6aafb">Hanekage</font>'s position.

While in <font color="a6aafb">Hanekage</font> form, Hanzo's body is invincible, while <font color="a6aafb">Hanekage</font> ignores obstacles and gains 50% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again or Upon Death</font>: <font color="a6aafb">Hanekage</font> returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 360<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> HP and becoming untargetable during the return. If <font color="a6aafb">Hanekage</font> is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6s, and the skill's cooldown will be doubled.
